notablePrerequisites: Either one card in hand or You control an X/1 creature.
description:
Equip an X/1 creature with Skullclamp to draws 2 cards.
The Locust God creates 2 1/1 insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Exile a card from your hand to Cadaverous Bloom to add {B}{B} or {G}{G}.
